svg.title: How IBM Sterling handles orders and partner data
svg.desc: Three steps on one line. Orders: real-time inventory and warehouse management, ship from store, curbside pickup and buy online, pick up in store, in IBM Sterling Order Management. Any format to any format: transformation and validation of structured, unstructured, industry-standard and custom data without complex coding, in IBM Sterling Transformation Extender. Adapters and APIs: adapters for AWS, MongoDB, HDFS and Kafka, and RESTful APIs.
